What is AdCreative.ai?

Generates advertising creatives - banners, social ads, video ads and text - trained on performance data so it scores each generated asset for likely conversion rate before you spend money on it.

Best for

High-volume ad creative generation with conversion scoring.

Main features

  • Ad creative generation in every major platform size
  • conversion-score prediction for each creative based on trained performance data
  • competitor ad insights showing what rivals are running
  • AI text and headline generation matched to the creative
  • product photoshoot generation placing products in AI-generated scenes
  • video ad generation
  • brand kit for fonts, colours and logos
  • integration with Google and Meta ad accounts to pull real performance data
  • bulk generation.

Practical use cases

  • Generating 50 ad variants for a campaign test in minutes
  • predicting which creative will convert before spending budget
  • producing platform-correct sizes without a designer
  • generating product lifestyle imagery without a photoshoot
  • analysing competitor creative strategy.

Who is it for?

  • Performance marketers, e-commerce brands, agencies running paid social and search at volume.

Pricing, free access & limits

Credit-based subscription tiers by credits and brands

Plans described in the source

Starter tiers from around $39-49/mo (limited credits, 1 brand). Professional tiers around $99-149/mo with more credits and brands. Ultimate/Scale tiers around $249-599/mo for agencies with many brands and high credit volumes. Enterprise custom. Annual billing discounted. Credits are consumed per creative downloaded, not per generation. AdCreative.ai runs very aggressive discounting and lifetime deals - the list price is rarely what buyers pay.

Free plan

No permanent free plan.

Free trial

Yes - 7-day free trial with a limited credit allowance; note the aggressive auto-renewal, which generates frequent complaints.

Usage limits to consider

Credit-metered per downloaded creative. Number of brands and connected ad accounts is tier-limited. Video and photoshoot generation consume more credits. Unused credits do not roll over.

Strengths & tradeoffs

These points summarize the supplied research, rather than hands-on test results.

Strengths noted in the source

  • The conversion-score prediction is the genuine differentiator - ranking creatives before spend is worth real money at any meaningful ad budget
  • platform-correct sizing at volume removes a tedious design task
  • competitor ad insights are useful for positioning
  • pulls real performance data from connected ad accounts to improve scoring.

Limitations to consider

  • Aggressive billing practices are the most consistent complaint - trial auto-renewal, difficult cancellation and unexpected charges appear repeatedly in user reviews
  • creative output is template-driven and can look generic
  • the conversion score is a proprietary prediction with no published methodology, so treat it as directional rather than authoritative
  • credits burn quickly
  • not suitable for brand-building creative, only performance.

Platforms, languages & integrations

Platforms

  • Web
  • Chrome extension
  • integrations with ad platforms

Languages

  • Ad text generation in 30+ languages including Arabic and French

API access

Yes - API available on higher tiers

Integrations and exports

  • Google Ads, Meta Ads Manager, LinkedIn Ads, Google Analytics, Shopify, WooCommerce, Zapier, Canva, Dropbox

Evaluation notes

Set a calendar reminder before the trial ends and cancel explicitly - billing complaints are the dominant theme in reviews of this product. Validate the conversion score against your own A/B results before trusting it to allocate budget.
